import ast,hashlib,json,platform,subprocess,sys
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
rows=[]
for name in subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only','--diff-filter=ACM','-z']).decode().split('\0'):
    if name.endswith('.py'):
        raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',':'+name]); ast.parse(raw,filename=name)
        rows.append({'path':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
r={'timestamp':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'status':'STAGED_PYTHON_SYNTAX_PASS','command':[sys.executable,*sys.argv],'cwd':str(Path.cwd()),'python':platform.python_version(),'checked_sources':rows,'mathematical_verification':False,'historical_parse_failure':'Preserved as byte-identical .py.failed-source.txt; it is not executable Python.'}
Path('acceleration/results/20261002_wave35_syntax01.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':r['status'],'source_count':len(rows)}))
